title: Other Cover on the Same Loss as a ShieldCare Plan
content:
## The manufacturer's warranty

The provision that a ShieldCare plan and a manufacturer's warranty are never both settled for the
same repair, and that a plan does not pay while the manufacturer's warranty on that item is still
running unless the peril is one the manufacturer excludes, is **no longer in force**: what the
plan meets where a manufacturer's warranty is in play now rests on the current basis, which is not
restated here.

The months a manufacturer's warranty runs for, by department, remain as recorded:

| Department | Months the manufacturer's warranty runs |
| --- | --- |
| laptops and tablets | 12 |
| mobile handsets | 12 |
| televisions and projectors | 12 |
| audio and home theatre | 12 |
| major appliances | 12 |
| small appliances | 12 |
| cameras and drones | 12 |
| gaming consoles | 12 |
| business IT fleet equipment | 36 |

## Cover held elsewhere by the customer

Where the item also carries cover from a card issuer or a household insurer, the retailer settles
only the part of the loss those have not met, and the customer is asked what has already been paid
rather than being paid twice.

## Two plans on one serial

A Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is never sold alongside another retailer plan on the same
serial, and where one is found on file the later sale is void and its premium returned.

## The food spoilage allowance

The food spoilage allowance is not paid where a household insurer has already met the same spoiled
food.

## The floor under this rule

Nothing in this rule reduces a payout below what the plan's own limits would give when no other
cover exists.

### Points of judgement

| Fact recorded | The rule's answer |
| --- | --- |
| A household insurer has met part of the loss | The retailer settles only the part not met |
| A household insurer has met the spoiled food in full | No food spoilage allowance is paid |
| A second retailer plan is found on the same serial | The later sale is void and its premium returned |
| No other cover exists at all | The plan's own limits stand untouched by this rule |
